title: Public API specification
deliverable: Stabilize pre-1.0 JSON envelopes, binary artifact routes, pagination, errors and capability negotiation.
acceptance: Local and HTTP transports pass shared use-case tests; framework request types never enter the application layer.
strict_verification: Independent client contract tests exercise version/errors/offsets/capabilities/idempotency; schemas expose no framework/database/provider types.

title: Job lifecycle API
deliverable: Add queued/running/succeeded/failed/cancelled/expired states, progress events and resumable observation.
acceptance: Reconnection and duplicated requests cannot create ambiguous terminal states or leak another principal’s job.
strict_verification: Authorized create/poll/cancel/result lifecycle has exactly one terminal state; replay/stale generation/lease and disconnect races cannot publish twice.

title: Artifact transfer API
deliverable: Add bounded uploads, integrity checks, range downloads, retention and explicit remote-consent UX.
acceptance: Incomplete uploads remain staged; large files do not travel as JSON Base64 payloads by default.
strict_verification: Upload/download/range quotas, checksums, abort and current permissions pass; oversized/traversal/partial artifacts cannot become readable completions.

title: Repository contracts
deliverable: Define atomic recipe revision saves, job leases, permissions, metadata search and transaction boundaries.
acceptance: Contracts describe domain semantics instead of generic execute-SQL methods; an in-memory adapter passes the suite.
strict_verification: Atomic commands define revision/conflict/idempotency/lease/pagination semantics; rollback and concurrent use-case tests pass before SQL optimization.

title: PostgreSQL adapter
deliverable: Implement parameterized queries, pool configuration and migrations outside core domain packages.
acceptance: Recipes and jobs pass repository tests on an actual PostgreSQL instance; driver row types stay in the adapter.
strict_verification: Real PostgreSQL runs the full repository contract, migrations and runtime least-privilege suite; no input/output payload is silently stored as SQL blobs.

title: Database TLS seam
deliverable: Wire tokio-postgres through a replaceable TLS connector and explicit identity/trust configuration.
acceptance: Certificate validation failures are fatal; a mock provider proves database TLS is not permanently tied to rustls.
strict_verification: Real database TLS rejects wrong host/root/expiry/plaintext downgrade; database-specific negotiation/channel binding stays in the adapter.

title: OpenBao database leases
deliverable: Evaluate and qualify the current PostgreSQL database plugin; separate migration and runtime identities and map lease revocation to pool behavior.
acceptance: Real leased login/expiry/revocation fixtures pass; stale pooled credentials are discarded; unsupported beta/plugin compatibility gets a new owned pass.

title: Identity and sessions
deliverable: Add server authentication, bounded sessions, token expiry, CSRF defenses and optional identity-provider integration.
acceptance: Authorization is enforced server-side for every object; browser-local use remains anonymous and database-free.
strict_verification: Reviewed identity/session flows pass wrong issuer/audience/nonce, replay, expiry, CSRF/origin and cookie negatives; credentials never appear in URLs/logs.

title: Workspace authorization
deliverable: Add owner/editor/viewer roles, tenant scoping and explicit service-account permissions.
acceptance: Cross-workspace and confused-deputy tests fail closed even without database-specific row-security features.
strict_verification: Cross-tenant and same-tenant revoked-object denials cover recipes/runs/artifacts/search; opaque IDs and cache/index grants never substitute for authority.

title: Hosted artifact publication fencing
deliverable: With repositories and workspace authority available, qualify object completion followed by manifest/run/outbox transaction. Recheck current authorization and server lease/generation fences; publish only through committed manifests and reconcile inaccessible orphan stages.
acceptance: Crash each finalize/commit/publish/cleanup cut point; duplicate completion, failed SQL commit, corrupt object, disk full, revoked reader and stale worker cannot publish partial/unauthorized output. Read bytes to verify hashes; cleanup never deletes a live referenced object.

title: Repository metadata search
deliverable: With PostgreSQL persistence and workspace authorization available, implement bounded saved-recipe metadata search behind SearchService. Approve names, descriptions, tags/categories and collection IDs; exclude secret-bearing or sensitive metadata, operation arguments and all payloads.
acceptance: Real PostgreSQL tests prove tenant/object permissions, malformed/bounded queries, deterministic pagination and immediate deletion/revocation. The UI/API works with Meilisearch disabled; local browser recipe search stays local.

title: Search projection and outbox
deliverable: Commit revisioned allowlisted search projections and outbox events atomically with repository changes; add idempotent retry, deletion tombstones, replay watermarks and bounded task/error retention.
acceptance: Transaction rollback leaves no event; crashes, duplicate/reordered delivery, concurrent edit/delete and poison events cannot resurrect old projections. Projection contains no recipe/input/result/SecretRef values and is fully rebuildable from authorized metadata.

title: Meilisearch Podman fixture
deliverable: Admit the latest reviewed Meilisearch image into an explicitly enabled rootless Podman profile with resource bounds, private network and qualified TLS. Obtain its initial master key from OpenBao before startup; persist service-issued scoped API keys in OpenBao before delivery, separating provisioning, index writer and search reader.
acceptance: Actual optional service start/restart passes; disabled profile starts no Meilisearch container and requests no Meilisearch credentials. Missing/revoked vault secrets, wrong TLS identity, unauthenticated requests and excessive key privileges fail; master keys never reach browser or application readers.

title: Meilisearch metadata adapter
deliverable: Implement runasmidja-search-meilisearch outside portable defaults using a current reviewed minimal client/SDK. Consume outbox projections, track asynchronous task completion/failure and expose bounded search candidates through the owned contract.
acceptance: Real server tests cover task acceptance versus completion, failed indexing, retry, queue ceilings, malformed queries, deadlines, scoped reader/writer credentials and exact projection fields. Shared repository/Meilisearch conformance passes without backend DTOs leaking into API types.

title: Search authorization and revocation
deliverable: Enforce server-owned tenant filters and authoritative current database permission/revision checks before returning metadata. Derive visible snippets, facets, counts and pagination only from authorized current state; keep browsers behind the application API.
acceptance: Two-tenant and same-tenant revoked-reader tests with a deliberately stale index reveal no hit, title, snippet, facet, count or object existence. Forged filter/cursor, stale edit/delete/revoke, permissions changed during a request and database outage deny access without trusting index grants.

title: Search backend switching and recovery
deliverable: Qualify explicit repository/meilisearch runtime selection, std-only optional feature and an authorized repository fallback on Meilisearch outage. Rebuild/switch using outbox watermarks without data/schema/UI migration; declare ranking/freshness differences and enforce bounded recovery.
acceptance: Run website/API tests in both compiled profiles and both runtime modes; disabled mode needs no search service/secrets. Outage, task failure, key rotation, corrupted/lost index, pagination across switches and cutover/replay drills preserve current permissions and database truth; performance measurements tune deployment choice rather than cancel adapter work.

title: Isolated execution workers
deliverable: Move remotely submitted CPU work into restricted processes with memory, CPU, disk and egress policies.
acceptance: A parser crash or non-cooperative job can be killed without taking down API or other tenants.
strict_verification: Real isolated processes reject forbidden syscalls/mounts/network; CPU/memory/PID/temp/FD exhaustion and hard kill of descendants leave inaccessible staging.

title: Worker isolation fault qualification
deliverable: Qualify actual delegated cgroup/namespace/seccomp/MAC, nonroot/capability/descriptor policies and bounded scratch for isolated untrusted jobs. Keep supervisor/deadline enforcement outside the worker and kill the complete process tree.
acceptance: CPU spin, OOM, PID/fork/FD/temp exhaustion, forbidden mounts/syscalls/egress and malformed IPC are tested on the deployment kernel. Descendants stop after kill and staged output remains inaccessible; missing kernel controls reject the profile rather than silently weaken it.

title: Admission and quotas
deliverable: Add principal/workspace job quotas, maximum artifacts, rate limits and queue backpressure.
acceptance: Repeated tiny requests and large expanding jobs cannot bypass aggregate resource accounting.
strict_verification: Admission precedes expensive work; concurrent tenant/global limits, rate limits and quota-service outage cannot oversubscribe or bypass resource reservations.

title: Valkey application adapter
deliverable: Implement bounded optional metadata/cache access behind application-owned CacheStore with scoped keys and revision-aware identities.
acceptance: Cache miss, outage, poison, stale revision and cross-tenant probes pass against Valkey; authoritative data and permissions survive without cache.

title: Valkey invalidation and outage
deliverable: Prove TTL, revocation invalidation, resource ceilings and eviction behavior without giving cache authority over authorization.
acceptance: Revoked grants are checked against authoritative state; connection failures do not bypass quotas; cache poisoning and invalidation races have regressions.

title: Durable jobs and leases
deliverable: Add job leases, fencing tokens, worker heartbeat, retry eligibility and idempotency records.
acceptance: Expired workers cannot finalize duplicate results; retry is prohibited for unsafe external side effects.
strict_verification: Crash/reassign/duplicate completion tests enforce authoritative fencing; stale/expired workers cannot renew or publish newer run output.

title: Server networking policy
deliverable: Centralize outbound connections, redirects, destination restrictions, credentials and HTTP limits.
acceptance: SSRF, rebinding, private/metadata destinations and mapped-address cases are covered before user HTTP operations are public.
strict_verification: Controlled DNS/connect/redirect fixtures deny rebinding, all forbidden A/AAAA/mapped/link-local destinations, credential forwarding and decompression excess.

title: DNS and connection destination binding
deliverable: Implement canonical native destination admission with all A/AAAA validation, IPv4-mapped IPv6 normalization, policy-owned resolution and connection to approved addresses while preserving Host/SNI. Revalidate retry/pool/TTL/policy changes and peer identity.
acceptance: Controlled DNS/TLS fixtures reject mixed public/private answers, rebinding between resolve/connect, metadata/private/link-local/reserved addresses, scoped/ambiguous forms and unknown peers. No SDK/client re-resolution bypass remains; explicit private-network operator policy is separately scoped.

title: Redirect and outbound transport policy
deliverable: Qualify each redirect/credential/timeout/decompression decision in the native broker; disable ambient proxy/Alt-Svc/coalescing bypasses. Inventory SDK/identity/search/object-store transports and isolate any client lacking required transport hooks.
acceptance: Private redirects, loops, retry/deadline/byte excess, signed-URL/header leaks, cross-origin credentials, ambient proxy and stale pooled-policy tests fail. An intentional proxy enforces final destinations; browser Fetch limitations are explicit and cannot trigger silent remote fallback.

title: Metadata-only observability
deliverable: Add health, readiness, redacted audit events, bounded metrics and structured operational errors.
acceptance: Default logs contain no raw inputs, outputs, secrets or high-cardinality user payload labels.
strict_verification: Sentinel payloads/keys/query bodies never enter default logs/metrics/traces; bounded IDs/counters still diagnose failures without sensitive labels.

title: Server deployment profile
deliverable: Ship a hardened single-node deployment with reverse-proxy and direct-TLS options, backups and cleanup jobs.
acceptance: Restart and restore drills preserve metadata/artifact consistency; insecure development defaults cannot silently become public.
strict_verification: Reproducible rootless deployment checks all actual isolation/secret/TLS/admission policies; public endpoints exclude administrative services and dev shortcuts.

title: Service TLS deployment policy
deliverable: Qualify native PostgreSQL/Valkey/OpenBao TLS, certificate identity, trust roots and private service networks independently of local fixture shortcuts.
acceptance: Wrong names, unknown roots, expired certificates, missing TLS and unauthorized service clients fail; deployment never publishes administrative endpoints.

title: OpenBao production recovery custody
deliverable: Separate production recovery shares, initial bootstrap identity and app credentials; automate operational configuration and rehearse restore and rotation.
acceptance: Independent custody/recovery, audit-disk failure, snapshot restore and expired bootstrap identity are tested; one-share local test material is rejected in production.

title: PostgreSQL beta-to-GA upgrade drill
deliverable: When available admit PostgreSQL 19 GA after upstream review; rehearse dump/restore or documented upgrade from the beta baseline.
acceptance: Restore and repository/authorization fixtures pass on pinned GA; no beta data directory is reused blindly; rollback is executable and 1.0 uses GA.

title: Server security gate
deliverable: Test authentication, object authorization, uploads, worker isolation, cancellation and resource abuse.
acceptance: Public remote execution stays disabled until isolation and quota tests pass; local web mode remains independently releasable.
strict_verification: Adversarial API/auth/worker/egress/storage assessment passes on the exact deployment; remediation/retest and operational recovery evidence precede exposure. All public untrusted-job routes stay disabled until authority, admission, isolation, fencing, egress, TLS and recovery gates pass together; earlier API rows are local/private integration only.
